hcontainer.heading: Arrangements relating to coronavirus response measures

content.p: In this Part:
Family Assistance Administration Act means the A New Tax System (Family Assistance) (Administration) Act 1999.
relevant period means the period beginning on 6 April 2020 and ending on 12 July 2020.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Relevant period not included in determining cessation of enrolment

content.p: Subparagraph 200B(1)(b)(iii) of the Family Assistance Administration Act applies as if the period of 14 weeks mentioned in that subparagraph did not include a week that occurred in the relevant period.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: No requirement to report provision of care to children during relevant period

content.p: An approved provider is not required under section 204B of the Family Assistance Administration Act to give a report for a week if the week occurred in the relevant period.
However, for the purposes of the operation of subsection 205A(1) of the Family Assistance Administration Act, the approved provider is taken to have been required to give the report.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Recovery of business continuity payments during relevant period

content.p: This item applies in relation to an amount paid under section 205A of the Family Assistance Administration Act to an approved provider in relation to a period that occurred in the relevant period.

The Minister may, by legislative instrument, make rules determining circumstances in which the whole or part of the amount is taken to be a debt due to the Commonwealth by the provider under Part 4 of the Family Assistance Administration Act.
Subitem (2) applies despite section 70 of the Family Assistance Administration Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: No set-off of business continuity payments during relevant period

content.p: Section 205B of the Family Assistance Administration Act does not apply in relation to a payment made under section 205A of that Act to an approved provider if the payment was made in relation to a period that occurred in the relevant period.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Certain Minister’s rules taken to be valid

content.p: The following, as in force at the commencement of this Schedule, are for all purposes taken to be, and always to have been, valid exercises of the power to make Minister’s rules under subsection 85GB(1) of the A New Tax System (Family Assistance) Act 1999:
(a) paragraphs 8(1)(h) and (i) of the Child Care Subsidy Minister’s Rules 2017;
(b) section 47AA of the Child Care Subsidy Minister’s Rules 2017.

If the operation of this Part would result in an acquisition of property (within the meaning of paragraph 51(xxxi) of the Constitution) from a person otherwise than on just terms (within the meaning of that paragraph), the Commonwealth is liable to pay a reasonable amount of compensation to the person.
If the Commonwealth and the person do not agree on the amount of the compensation, the person may institute proceedings in:
the Federal Court of Australia; or
the Supreme Court of a State or Territory;
for the recovery from the Commonwealth of such reasonable amount of compensation as the court determines.
